mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.title, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = q.user_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 ORDER BY (q.like_count * 3 + q.answer_count * 2 + q.view_count) DESC, q.last_active_at DESC, q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = q.user_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND q.topic_id = #{topicId}
AND q.answer_count = 0
ORDER BY
q.created_at q.like_count q.like_count DESC, q.answer_count DESC, q.view_count DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content, COALESCE(ans.answerContent, '') AS answerContent, q.category_id AS categoryId, q.topic_id AS topicId, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, q.status, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.question_id AS questionId, GROUP_CONCAT(a.content SEPARATOR ' ') AS answerContent FROM qa_answer a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY a.question_id ) ans ON ans.questionId = q.id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content, COALESCE(ans.answerContent, '') AS answerContent, q.category_id AS categoryId, q.topic_id AS topicId, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, q.status, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.question_id AS questionId, GROUP_CONCAT(a.content SEPARATOR ' ') AS answerContent FROM qa_answer a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY a.question_id ) ans ON ans.questionId = q.id WHERE q.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT q.id, q.title, c.name AS categoryName, q.image_urls AS imageUrlsRaw, q.status, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.id AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 ) AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.accepted_answer_id AS acceptedAnswerId, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN qa_category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} AND q.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id, q.title, LEFT(COALESCE(q.content, ''), 120) AS summary, q.image_urls AS imageUrlsRaw, q.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, q.topic_id AS topicId, t.title AS topicTitle, q.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt FROM qa_question q
LEFT JOIN rec_user_interest ri ON ri.user_id = #{userId} AND ri.category_id = q.category_id
LEFT JOIN qa_category c ON c.id = q.category_id LEFT JOIN qa_topic t ON t.id = q.topic_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = q.user_id WHERE q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1
AND (q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND q.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND q.topic_id = #{topicId}
AND q.answer_count = 0
ORDER BY
q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC
( COALESCE(ri.score, 0) * 5 + q.like_count * 3 + q.favorite_count * 2 + q.answer_count * 2 + q.view_count ) DESC, COALESCE(ri.updated_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') DESC, q.last_active_at DESC, q.id DESC
q.view_count DESC, q.answer_count DESC, q.like_count DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content, q.status, q.image_urls AS imageUrlsRaw, q.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, q.topic_id AS topicId, t.title AS topicTitle, q.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, q.view_count AS viewCount, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN qa_category c ON c.id = q.category_id LEFT JOIN qa_topic t ON t.id = q.topic_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = q.user_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.delete_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_question SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
UPDATE qa_question SET answer_count = CASE WHEN answer_count + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE answer_count + #{delta} END WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
